glee: Quick drop: new account form proto. Proposal = show errors per-field after blur, plus a tiny sticky summary only after failed submit. Feedback?

vin: Sounds good. Key: don't show errors on initial load. Use touched state. Debounce validation ~200ms to avoid flicker.

sasha: Required marker: keep the asterisk but include sr-only 'required' + aria-required. Visual-only asterisks can be problematic.

aria: Accessibility checklist: error nodes need `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` when surfaced on blur/submit. Link errors via `aria-describedby`. Banner should be announced when it appears.

glee: Delete flows: for workspace delete, prefer typed-confirm. For single items, use checkbox + undo snackbar. Mobile: prefer checkbox rather than typed confirm unless risk is very high.

vin: Metrics: emit `form.validation.strategy=hybrid` on submit and `delete.confirmation=typed|checkbox|undo`.

sasha: Visual: asterisk must have sufficient contrast or include text. Also avoid layout jump when errors appear; reserve space.

design-ci: Note: exported figma frame to /protos/forms/hybrid-compact

glee: I'll write a short RFC capturing rules + accessibility checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
